text: Does the mass feel hard and fixed to the surrounding tissue, or is it soft and mobile? Also, have you noticed any skin changes like dimpling or redness, or any nipple discharge?

text: Given the rapid growth and lack of pain, I need to rule out an inflammatory or high-grade malignancy. REQUEST TEST: Breast Ultrasound and Mammography
